sources.title: Baguettotron: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: The model's reasoning notation (→ for derivation, ∴ for conclusions) creates transparent math workflows that are easier to verify and debug than opaque outputs. Creative and specialized writing tasks. The model was trained on unusual synthetic exercises including lipograms (text avoiding certain letters), layout poems, and cooking instructions.
